news_summary: TNB August 27 Q2 report shows revenue rising to RM18.236 billion from RM16.835 billion but attributable earnings falling to RM888.8 million from RM1,158.1 million; H1 earnings also fell. Operating margin declined and FX translation shifted from a gain to a small loss; strong analyst buy counts contrast with earnings pressure, while tariff reconciliation is incomplete.
